title: Contract-Carrying Analytical Physics Receipts for CAD

predecessor.relationship: versioned successor; predecessor evidence and claims remain unchanged

research_question: For bounded analytical-physics requests over NeuroCAD agent primitives, do geometry-, material-, and load-bound receipts detect predeclared stale or contradictory analyses that an unbound request file cannot detect, while retaining deterministic valid-case behavior?
scientific_objective: Evaluate a narrow executable provenance and invalidation contract for analytical CAD screening, not the physical validity of FEA, CFD, fabrication, or safety claims.

hypotheses.statement: Valid bound requests are accepted deterministically with exact input, geometry, material, load, and request hashes.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any predeclared valid case is rejected or produces nondeterministic scientific fields.

hypotheses.statement: The full binding rejects every predeclared geometry/input, material/input, load/input, and expected-hash contradiction; hash-only and unbound controls do not detect semantic contradictions they do not evaluate.
hypotheses.falsifier: The full binding accepts any in-scope contradiction or a control is credited with a detection it does not actually perform.

hypotheses.statement: Full and hash-only receipts detect every predeclared post-result geometry mutation, whereas unbound requests expose no machine-verifiable geometry freshness check.
hypotheses.falsifier: A bound receipt remains current after an in-scope geometry mutation.

hypotheses.statement: Non-geometric label changes and revision-only changes do not invalidate a geometry receipt.
hypotheses.falsifier: A predeclared non-geometric mutation changes the canonical geometry hash.

intended_contribution: An open, strict, machine-readable reference implementation and controlled conformance study for hash-bound analytical-physics receipts. No algorithmic-novelty, physical-validation, safety, or general CAD/CAE claim is intended.

included: exact model-input contradiction checks where mappings are unambiguous
excluded: full CSG mass or surface evaluation
comparison with commercial PLM or CAE systems

protected_evaluation.policy: Freeze source revision, generator, case manifest hash, endpoints, thresholds, exclusions, and analysis before the single confirmatory execution. Development cases may not be copied into confirmatory evidence.

datasets.purpose: single frozen controlled confirmatory conformance matrix

decisions.decision: Treat Physics v2 as a successor study rather than reopening the terminal controlled-compiler study.
decisions.reason: The new mechanism and research question are materially different.

decisions.decision: Reject algorithmic novelty and physical-validation claims.
decisions.reason: Digital-thread traceability, model associativity, and simulation provenance have substantial prior art; the contribution is an executable bounded reference contract.

decisions.decision: Exhaust the two-revision development budget before protocol freeze.
decisions.reason: Revision 1 repaired the retained path-resolution failure; revision 2 completed control-arm scoring and protected-run fail-closed gates. Further version-1 changes are prohibited.

failures.detail: Free plus speculative memory was approximately 104 MiB, below the 512 MiB floor; no protected or expensive scientific run is authorized in this state.
